title: Earning $200 a week and giving money away
summary: He made $200 weekly, spent it freely and helped relatives.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: How much were you making a week with that band when you went to Cafe Society?
Did you continue to make $200 the whole time that you worked with that band?
It's according to where you play.
What kind of things were you doing with that money? That was a lot of money at that time, in 1940, $200 a week.
I know, but on what? What kind of things would you buy? You had the best clothes of all the musicians around.
Just went out and had a good time.
Giving it away, helping other people. I had a whole lot of people to help.
How do you mean? Your family?
